author: Patchwork
source: Windows source v5.1.8, d2a4f8bc92a0fd296943a7cdd15f4f870c8a87f9; experimental local client modifications

patches.name: Disable usage telemetry
patches.description: Stops both authenticated and pre-login statistical event senders. Diagnostic reports submitted by the user are separate.

patches.name: Hide upgrade promotions
patches.description: Hides shared upgrade banners/feature cards, subscription badges, four explicit Upgrade buttons (including change-server and network notices), promotional announcement offers/popups, and restricted server-row upgrade actions. Available rows keep Connect and maintenance checks. NPS surveys and normal service notices remain available; actual account plan and backend eligibility are unchanged.

patches.name: Keep VPN Accelerator enabled
patches.description: Keeps VPN Accelerator on, opens its settings without an upgrade prompt, and shows its enabled state. This overrides the saved off toggle; restore this patch to return toggle control. Live speed improvements are not verified.

patches.name: Remove local server change delay
patches.description: Makes the desktop cooldown check accept a server change and report zero remaining time. Server limits can still apply.

patches.name: LAN connections controls
patches.description: Exposes the shared advanced-settings screen and uses the saved LAN access toggle. The same screen also displays custom DNS and NAT controls; their effective settings have separate checks.

patches.name: Custom DNS controls
patches.description: Exposes the shared advanced-settings screen and uses the saved custom DNS toggle and resolver list. Test DNS behavior on your network before relying on it.

patches.name: NetShield client controls
patches.description: Opens the NetShield widget and settings and uses the saved toggle. This changes client checks; Proton's servers still decide whether DNS filtering is available for the account.

patches.name: Split tunneling client controls
patches.description: Opens the split-tunneling widget and settings and uses the saved routing toggle. VPN routing and kill-switch interaction still need a live network test.

patches.name: Connection preference controls
patches.description: Shows the default-connection and excluded-location controls and reads the saved default connection. Account-eligible servers and normal connection validation still apply.

patches.name: Connection profile controls
patches.description: Shows profile creation/editing and clears the profile row's local restriction. Connections still pass through Proton's account and location validation.

patches.name: Free country and individual server selection
patches.description: Expand a free country to see individual free servers; Search and standard Recents keep the selected server ID and show Connect. Candidate filtering remains free/non-business with no server fallback. Paid-only recent features/profiles keep their checks. Paid accounts retain city/state browsing. Maintenance remains active. Requires a signed-in or guest VPN session.

patches.name: Hide paid country modes
patches.description: Hides Secure Core, P2P and Tor country tabs on free accounts, keeping All countries and free server selection. Paid accounts retain their mode tabs. This changes navigation only; it does not grant access to paid servers. Restart Proton after an account-plan change.

patches.name: Guest VPN session
patches.description: Adds Continue as guest with native loading-page cancellation, bounded requests, encrypted session storage and native VPN authorization, certificate renewal, refresh, restart and logout. Fixes sign-in cancelling itself when the page unloads. Contains executable managed client code; source: source/GuestClient.cs. Normal sign-in remains available. Guest accounts retain backend free-server limits.

patches.name: Custom accent color
patches.description: Choose the color used by primary buttons, links, focus borders and accent brushes, plus its foreground text color. Applies to Light and Dark themes. Choose contrasting colors for readable controls.

patches.name: Custom switch colors
patches.description: Choose enabled toggle-switch track and knob colors while keeping the native switch layout, disabled states and keyboard controls. Applies to Light and Dark themes.
